canonical_project: Google Chesterfield portfolio / Project Peanut, Skye, and Loch
aliases: Google Chesterfield portfolio / Project Peanut, Skye, and Loch
Project Peanut, Project Skye, Project Loch
status_as_of_cutoff: As of the August 11, 2026 refresh, Chesterfield County's July 2026 data-center status table lists Peanut LLC at 2100 Bermuda Hundred Road as under construction with three buildings, and lists Upper Magnolia Green at 4201 Moseley Road plus Watkins Centre at 750 Watkins Centre Parkway as zoning approved. USACE public notices identify Google LLC as applicant for Project Loch and Project Skye DA permit applications, but no official source located confirms MW capacity, issued federal DA permits, certificates of occupancy, energization, or full buildout.
evidence_grade: A - official county and federal public records confirm portfolio owner identity, site-level county status, zoning status for Upper Magnolia Green and Watkins Centre, and active federal DA permit applications for Skye and Loch; no official source located for MW capacity, certificate of occupancy, energization, or full buildout.

site_statuses.evidence_note: County Data Center Project Status table lists Peanut LLC as under construction with three buildings as of July 2026.

site_statuses.evidence_note: County lists zoning approved as of July 2026; USACE public notice says Google requested a DA permit for five data centers, three substations, parking, roads, utilities, and stormwater facilities.

site_statuses.status: approved-permitted / federal aquatic-resource permit review pending
site_statuses.evidence_note: County lists zoning approved as of July 2026; USACE public notice says Google requested a DA permit for three data center buildings, three substations, roads, parking lots, utilities, and stormwater facilities.

actions.action_type: government project update / construction status reported by company
actions.result_status: County article reported that Google had announced a data-center campus and that a company spokesperson said it had already broken ground on a 300-plus-acre Bermuda Hundred site. The article records no county vote or permit approval.
actions.access_caveat: Official article attributes the groundbreaking statement to Google; it is not an approval instrument.
actions.evidence_note: Construction-status report, not a construction permit or certificate of occupancy.

actions.result_status: A resident public comment referenced 2700 Bermuda Hundred Road, Google, and Peanut LLC and raised concerns about nondisclosure and public notice. The published comments do not show a Board action or vote on the project.
actions.access_caveat: This is a public-comments file, not minutes or an approval packet.
actions.evidence_note: Public comment is not a land-use decision.

actions.government_body: Chesterfield County Community Development / plan review
actions.result_status: Weekly active-plan review record routed PROJECT PEANUT EP, case 25PR1323, plan type PA REG, for review on January 23; the record's final-status field was blank/NA. No approval can be inferred.
actions.access_caveat: Weekly review list is an administrative routing/status document, not a final site-plan decision.
actions.evidence_note: Site-plan review is land-use administration; it is not a building permit.

actions.government_body: Chesterfield County / Virginia DEQ air-permit suitability process
actions.action_type: local governing body certification for air permit application
actions.result_status: County administrator signed the Peanut LLC DEQ land-use suitability form, certifying the proposed data-center facility with diesel-fired emergency engine generators, fuel storage tanks, and cooling towers as suitable/consistent with applicable local ordinances for DEQ air-permit completeness purposes.
actions.access_caveat: Suitability certification supports a state air-permit application; it is not itself an air permit, building permit, or certificate of occupancy.
actions.evidence_note: Official county-posted DEQ form identifies Peanut LLC and Google contact information.

actions.government_body: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Norfolk District
actions.action_type: Clean Water Act Section 404 / Department of the Army permit application notice
actions.result_status: USACE published public notice NAO-2026-00182 for Project Loch, identifying Google LLC as applicant and a proposed campus of three data center buildings, three substations, roads, parking lots, utilities, and stormwater management facilities; public comments were due June 11, 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Public notice confirms receipt of an application and comment period; it does not confirm permit issuance.
actions.evidence_note: Federal permit review concerns impacts to waters of the United States associated with Tomahawk Creek.

actions.government_body: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Norfolk District
actions.action_type: Clean Water Act Section 404 / Department of the Army permit application notice
actions.result_status: USACE published public notice NAO-2026-00282 / VMRC 26-0360 for Project Skye, identifying Google LLC as applicant and a proposed campus of five data centers, three substations, parking, roads, utilities, and stormwater management facilities; public comments were due July 28, 2026.
actions.access_caveat: Public notice confirms receipt of an application and comment period; it does not confirm permit issuance.
actions.evidence_note: Federal permit review concerns impacts to waters of the United States associated with Deep Creek, a James River tributary.

actions.result_status: County Data Center Project Status table lists Peanut LLC at 2100 Bermuda Hundred Road as under construction with three buildings and a 6.000 MGD maximum water usage; Upper Magnolia Green at 4201 Moseley Road and Watkins Centre at 750 Watkins Centre Parkway are listed as zoning approved, with building counts not specified, and maximum water usage of 1.755 MGD and 0.850 MGD respectively.
actions.access_caveat: County status table is not a certificate of occupancy, energization notice, or MW-capacity disclosure.
actions.evidence_note: Official county page also states the Upper Magnolia Green and Watkins Centre future sites were rezoned for data-center use in May 2025.

owner: Google LLC / Google-affiliated site entities including Peanut LLC; county page says Chesterfield finalized agreements with Google for three planned data center sites.
